title: Treatise on the Forward Chopping Step
summary: Joins the forward step to the kukri chop and shows how qi in the stride lengthens each cut.

title: The Notch and Hook Handbook
summary: Teaches students to catch weapons in the notch and to pull limbs with the belly under a steady qi flow.

title: Kukri Against the Long Haft
summary: Shows how a short chopping blade closes on a spear or staff and cuts the haft in two.

title: Studies in the Two-Handed Hew
summary: Develops the two-handed grip for the heaviest hewing cuts with qi gathered through the shoulders.

title: A Course in Qi-Weighted Chopping
summary: Trains a full ladder of chops where qi added at the right instant makes the blade fall heavier.

title: Close-Quarter Belly Work
summary: Covers cuts and hooks used inside arm's reach where the inward belly does its best work.

title: The Draw-and-Return Canon
summary: Builds on the sheath draw with a returning cut and qi that carries the blade back to guard.

title: Primer of the Pinned Blade
summary: Shows how to pin an opposing weapon against the ground or body and finish with one chop.
